mechanism_narrative: A low and stable federal funds rate environment reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% within a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has increased by more than 0.3pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in demand, triggering a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations fall, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1.0% month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO above 105.0), manufacturing output expansion supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above 105.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by high employment growth (PAYEMS above 150,000 monthly), supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a slowing GDP growth environment (GDPC1 quarterly growth below 1.0%) combined with weak consumer demand (RSAFS growth below 0.5%), corporate revenue expectations decline, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 < 1.0% and RSAFS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based supply shock, reducing corporate output and profitability, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline by more than 1.0% month-over-month, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.
